task_description: Implement multi-student support for parent/tutor portal. A tutor with multiple children should see all linked students after login, switch between them, and receive notifications for all. Uses existing tutores table with one row per student-tutor link.

verification.summary: All 5 PHP files pass php -l syntax validation. JS file reviewed manually (node --check unavailable due to sandbox proxy). All multi-student logic properly implemented across login, dashboard, profile, FCM token registration, and logout.
